$comment: Read by scripts/starter/prune.mjs, scripts/plugins/plugin.mjs and pnpm starter:init. Every optional piece of the starter is a feature here; the paths are what goes when it is dropped, and every other place that mentions it is wrapped in `flama:begin <id>` / `flama:end <id>` markers. `pnpm starter:check` (CI) fails when a feature is referenced outside its paths and markers, so this file cannot go stale silently. A `json` edit's `set` value is a copy of the file it edits — the version an install writes back — so bumping that dependency means bumping it here too; `starter:check` names both values until they agree. `keeps` names what a feature deliberately leaves behind when it goes, and why.
